traits.bark_colour.note: The bark colour chosen by eye for appearance (see its note), as a screen colour: it stood as appearance.bark [0.4, 0.33, 0.27], which is linear light, so the trunk drew pale grey to white beside photographs of the species (2026-10-23). It stands here in sRGB, as bark colours are picked, and the bark rule (tracheophyta) turns it into linear light.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: An evergreen woody subshrub (the model record: shrub, woody, 0.15-0.4 m), drawn by the shrub form. Plantaginaceae has no shrub form of its own, so it grows by the flowering plants' broadleaf default.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): floral formula ↓ K(5) [C(5) A4:1°] G(2); flower zygomorphic. The same on p. 328 for var. scouleri.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): flower 5-merous: 5 sepals, fused; 5 petals fused into a tube.

traits.perianth_fused.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): 5 petals fused into a tube; p. 328: corolla 5, fused.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): 5 petals fused into a tube; drawing notes: a bilateral tubular flower.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 328 (pdf pp. 344-345; ref floral-2026-10-15#1250), Penstemon fruticosus var. scouleri, Fig. 11.24A: corolla bilabiate, 2 upper and 3 lower lobes, a broad lower lip.

traits.stamens.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): 4 fertile stamens, fused to the corolla; p. 328: 4, on the corolla tube.

traits.staminodes.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): fifth stamen sterile, 1 staminode; p. 328: 1 adaxial staminode (elaborate).

traits.carpels.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): carpels 2, fused (syncarpous); p. 328: 2, median.

traits.ovary_position.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Penstemon fruticosus as the worked floral formula (pdf p. 57, printed pp. 39-44; ref floral-2026-10-15#199): ovary superior; p. 328 agrees.

generator.params.note: Kept from the template, Oregon boxleaf (12 stems from the foot, branches at 45 degrees), for a low many-stemmed evergreen subshrub; sizes, leaf life and flowers come from the traits by the library's rules. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.3 m tall at 12 years in the open, within the model record's usual 0.15-0.4 m. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
